'''Ivress''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was a member of the [[Order of Revan]] and became the commander of ex-Imperial Revanite forces stationed on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] [[Sky Ridge Island]], including [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Raygus Mol]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Balko]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tarsten]]. Ivress was at odds with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Milenec]] who commanded the ex-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Revanite forces. Despite being united by a common cause, he did not believe Milenec was truly committed to [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] goals.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ivress's fate varies greatly between light and dark side options for both sides. Imperials can fool Ivress into detaining Milenec and his men for treason or simply kill him outright. Republic players can kill him personally or have Milenec and his men take him into custody.
